newsitem.title: GHANA: Gold stocks draw down Ghana Bourse.
newsitem.headline: Gold stocks draw down Ghana Bourse.

text.p: Ghana stock indicators were weighed down by Ashanti Goldfields shares on Wednesday, reflecting recent subdued world gold prices, despite marginal gains today in London gold trading, Paris and New York.
The GSE All-Share Index fell 2.44 points to 376.04 from 378.48 at Monday's close, while market capitalisation slipped to 3,015.34 billion cedis from 3,110.73 billion.
Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd lost 1,000 cedis, closing at 27,000, but its merger with Australian mining group Golden Shamrock has added to a strong portfolio centred in Africa.
Offers again outnumbered bids, with 1.27 million shares against 177,190, in thin volume of 15,520 shares.
